pages.text: Upon death, $(l:offsprings/weaver)$(c)$(o)Weavers$() can rarely drop a Memory Core. These can be consumed as is, to gain experience, or be used to craft a Concentration Core. Alternatively, they can also be produced with the use of a $(l:blocks/weaving_mechanism)$(c)$(o)Weaving Mechanism$().
The Concentration core is a vital component for creating willful weapons. These can express unique abilities and also gain the capability of hurting divine beings, such as angels.
